nonBlockingIssues.description: Missing tests for core interaction behaviors (click navigation, double-click expansion, drag pinning). Manual verification via agent-browser mitigates this gap.
useEntity and useEntityRelations called with empty string when not in focus mode. Hooks have enabled: !!id to prevent API calls but pattern is slightly wasteful.
Potential duplicate edges when expanding neighbors if same relation returned from multiple entity lookups. Consider deduplicating by edge ID.
